method.what: per key, the dB that brings SSO's Long's level at CC1 64 to within T of a smooth curve over pitch: the <Articulation keyLevels> of each wind and brass patch's Long ([levels] evenKeys)
method.level: loudDb at CC1 64 (sso_winds_cc1_semitone.json, sso_gap_cc1_semitone.json: every semitone, median of 4 takes = the round robins' mean)
method.deviation: level - the Theil-Sen line through the 8 nearest other keys, at the key
method.threshold: T = 1.5 dB: the 80th percentile of |deviation| of the TU Berlin database's ff tones by the same estimator (Weinzierl et al. 2018; the instruments of real_range.py WINDS, pooled)
method.correction: -sign(d) max(0, |d| - T), rounded to 0.01 dB; keys under 0.05 dB left out; for the patches whose key pattern follows the real player's (REAL_SHAPE: Oboe Solo, Oboes a2; each patch's "target") TU's deviation at ff - d at the keys TU measured (the owner, 2026-10-28: match the real oboe's key shape; TU one take a pitch)
method.byCc: each CC1 point's deviations, for the record (MuseScore plays the CC1 64 one: realRange takes the rest)
method.rr: |A - B| of the two round robins at CC1 64 per key (rmsDbTakes A B A B): not correctable per note
method.measures: rms over keys and CC1 points of the deviation by loudDb against loud1sDb and rmsDb
